jobs.title: MSC Finance Manager, Chicago Plant
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

As the Finance Manager for the Chicago Plant, you will provide leadership and oversight across financial planning, controls, and operational reporting. You will play a critical role in driving financial performance, ensuring compliance, and partnering with plant leadership to achieve business targets. In the Controller's absence, you will assume full responsibility for the plant's finance function.

How You Will Contribute
- Partner with the Plant Controller to provide strategic financial guidance to plant leadership, translating insights into actionable recommendations that support net productivity and capital expenditure targets.

- Lead the financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with strategic objectives.

- Own the monthly process for manufacturing financials, ensuring compliance with accounting standards and continuous cycle-time improvement.

- Manage the plant's risk and opportunity profile, driving forecast accuracy to control spending and achieve financial results.

- Lead cost and budget ownership across the plant, ensuring proper governance, training, and accountability around cost centers.

- Drive the loss analysis and loss elimination agenda, coordinating the master planning process and aligning with the cluster's productivity targets.

- Monitor site and cluster KPIs — waste, overtime, fixed costs, overheads — and provide actionable insights for continuous improvement.

- Ensure robust inventory management procedures, BOM and MR accuracy.

- Support the Engineering team with appropriation requests and post-investment evaluations.

- Supervise and develop the plant finance team, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional growth.

- Maintain a strong internal controls environment to ensure accuracy of financial data and compliance with corporate policies.

What You Will Bring
- TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in financial planning, manufacturing cost accounting, and internal controls — including analyzing and reporting financial performance across all KPIs and supporting investment decisions and cost management.

- BUSINESS ACUMEN and understanding of CPG/manufacturing dynamics. Relevant experience in a large regional or global corporation.

- LEADERSHIP SKILLS including business partnering, team management, and the ability to influence and communicate across functions and levels.

- GROWTH/DIGITAL MINDSET with the ability to leverage technology and ERP systems to improve efficiency.

- INTEGRITY and sound judgement aligned with company values and external regulations.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or related field.

- 7–10 years of progressive finance/accounting experience, with significant time in a manufacturing environment.

- Prior supervisory or team leadership experience required.

- Strong expertise in manufacturing cost accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.

- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling.

- Experience with ERP systems; S/4HANA experience is a plus.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders

Location:
Chicago Plant
7300 S Kedzie Ave
Chicago, IL 60629

Salary and Benefits:

The base salary range for this position is $122,000 to $167,750; the exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education and location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program with possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results.

In addition, Mondelez International offers the following benefits: health insurance, wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education related programs, paid holidays and vacation time. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

No Relocation support available

The United States is the largest market in the Mondelēz International family with a significant employee and manufacturing footprint. Here, we produce our well-loved household favorites to provide our consumers with the right snack, at the right moment, made the right way. We have corporate offices, sales, manufacturing and distribution locations throughout the U.S. to ensure our iconic brands—including Oreo and  Chips Ahoy! cookies, Ritz, Wheat Thins and Triscuit crackers, and Swedish Fish and Sour Patch Kids confectionery products —are close at hand for our consumers across the country.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

You will be manager in a team responsible for the overall financial integrity and performance of a country, category, Supply Chain or FP&A. You will support the Senior Manager or Director in data collection to prepare business proposals, verify assumptions, check daily execution and support delivery of overall objectives and ensure the integrity and timeliness of reporting. You may also have a direct report or manage third party providers resources.

How you will contribute

You will:
- Manage and execute aspects of finance planning and performance management process and related financial decisions potentially including Strategic Plan and Annual Contract planning/forecasting, target development, financial performance reporting/analysis, financial modeling and decision support for a focused scope within a region, business unit, country, Supply Chain, Mondelēz International Business Services or Corporate Finance team. You will own data collection and verify data integrity
- Ensure a strong controls and compliance environment in your area of scope and ensure full compliance with our policies
- Help the senior manager and the business prepare critical financial data and insight that enable perspectives for business strategies and decisions
- Lead projects to improve efficiencies and improvements to ways of working and embrace a mindset of continuous improvement
- Contribute to a high-performing Finance team. You will also invest in personal development and the development of Finance peers and drive our Finance talent agenda within the organization, with a focus on local FP&A pipeline

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
- TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in financial planning and performance management including data collection and structuring, analyzing, planning and reporting company financial performance across all financial KPIs and investment decisions and cost management to achieve financial targets
- BUSINESS ACUMEN and understanding of our business, consumer packaged goods industry, and local snacking market dynamics. Relevant experience in a regional/local business
- LEADERSHIP SKILLS including experience with business partnering and communication skills across a large regional or local public company
- GROWTH/DIGITAL MINDSET and the ability to identify/execute opportunities and leverage technology to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness
- INTEGRITY and sound judgement in all decisions and interactions aligned with our values and policies and external regulations

More about this role

What you need to know about this position:

- The Category Finance Manager is the end-to-end finance business partner for the West Africa category portfolio. This is a senior, hands-on role requiring a commercially astute finance professional who will serve as the strategic financial adviser to the Category and Marketing leadership teams. You will own the full category P&L, drive brand investment decisions, and deliver the financial analysis and insight that shapes category strategy. You will operate with a high degree of independence, manage multiple senior stakeholders, and work to tight deadlines in a fast-paced commercial environment.

What extra ingredients you will bring:

Category Business Partnering & Strategic Finance
- Act as the primary finance business partner across the full category value chain from strategy through to execution, partnering with Marketing, Sales, and Supply Chain leadership.
- Lead category strategy planning, annual contract development, and long-range strategic planning processes.
- Own the category P&L end-to-end: reporting, analysis, forecasting, and variance management.

Financial Analysis, Insight & Decision Support
- Perform in-depth financial analysis to generate actionable insight that directly informs senior leadership decision-making.
- Prepare robust business cases and financial justifications for investment proposals, innovation projects, and cost initiatives.
- Lead brand performance analysis, including marketing/A&C investment effectiveness, pricing strategy and architecture reviews, and promotional ROI assessment.

FP&A, Forecasting & Reporting
- Drive the monthly forecasting cycle, rolling estimates, and periodic financial reporting for the category.
- Deliver accurate, timely P&L reporting with clear commentary on performance drivers, risks, and opportunities.
- Ensure data integrity across all planning and reporting outputs.

Brand Investment & Pricing
- Partner with Marketing to evaluate and recommend brand investment decisions, including advertising, consumer promotion, and trade spend allocation.
- Support pricing strategy development and architecture to optimize revenue growth and margin delivery.

Project Leadership & Stakeholder Management
- Lead and participate in cross-functional projects aimed at improving commercial performance and ways of working.
- Chair or co-lead project meetings, manage timelines, and drive accountability for deliverables.
- Engage confidently with senior leaders, including the BU Finance Director and Category/Marketing Directors, providing clear, well-structured financial perspectives.
- Ensure a strong controls and compliance environment within the category finance scope, in line with MDLZ policies.

Education / Certifications:

- University degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics.

Job specific requirements:

Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with 5+ years of progressive finance experience, ideally within FMCG Sector.
Strong business acumen: deep understanding of commercial drivers, consumer goods dynamics, and local/regional beverage and snacking markets.
Proven analytical capability: able to translate complex data into clear, decision-ready insight.
Independent and self-directed: comfortable owning deliverables end-to-end with minimal supervision.
Mature, resilient professional: manages competing priorities, and consistently meets tight deadlines.
Excellent stakeholder management: credible and influential with senior leaders; able to challenge constructively.
Strong communication skills: can present financial narratives clearly to both finance and non-finance audiences.
Growth and digital mindset: identify opportunities to leverage technology and improve efficiency.
Integrity: sound judgement aligned with MDLZ values, policies, and external regulations.

Travel requirements:
- Limited

Work schedule:

No Relocation support available

Mondelēz International’s Sub Saharan Africa Business Unit is made up of three key focus areas namely Southern Africa, West Africa and the Rest of Africa Markets.   The Business Unit is home to approximately 1000 Makers and Bakers who strive to bring only the best quality and loved brands to our consumers. Mondelēz International in Sub Saharan Africa is proud to house global legacy brands including Cadbury Dairy Milk, Oreo, Halls and Bournvita, together with local jewels such as Cadbury LunchBar, Chappies, TomTom and Dentyne.   The Business Unit’s Markets have consistently been awarded Top Employer certification, and has been recognised as a Top Employer in Africa.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Chocolate FP&A Manager, India
Location - Mumbai HO

About the Role
We are looking for a seasoned finance professional to serve as the Finance Business Partner for our Chocolate Category . This is not a traditional financial reporting role — it is a strategic, end-to-end business ownership position where you will act as the financial conscience and co-pilot for the Chocolate business. You will be deeply embedded in the category team , influencing decisions across the value chain — from sourcing and manufacturing to marketing, sales, and P&L delivery .

Main Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnership
- Own the end-to-end P&L for the Chocolate category, driving top-line growth and bottom-line profitability

- Act as a trusted advisor to the Category Head and cross-functional leadership on all financial and commercial decisions

- Co-create the Annual Contract (AC) and Long-Range Strategic Plan (LRP) for the Chocolate portfolio

- Lead scenario planning, business modeling , and "what-if" analyses to evaluate new opportunities, product launches, and market expansion strategies

Revenue & Commercial Finance
- Partner with Sales and Trade Marketing to design and evaluate trade spend, pricing strategies , and promotional effectiveness

- Analyze channel and customer profitability to optimize the route-to-market strategy

- Drive Revenue Growth Management (RGM) initiatives including price-pack architecture, mix optimization , and elasticity modeling

Cost & Supply Chain Finance
- Collaborate with Procurement and Supply Chain teams to manage input cost volatility (cocoa, sugar, dairy, packaging) and drive cost-saving programs

- Own the standard costing process , manufacturing variances , and conversion cost optimization

- Evaluate make vs. buy decisions , co-packing arrangements , and capacity investment proposals

Innovation & Portfolio Management
- Provide financial leadership on New Product Development (NPD) — from business case creation to post-launch evaluation

- Assess portfolio health through SKU rationalization, margin analysis , and contribution mapping

- Build robust financial models for brand extensions, premiumization strategies , and adjacency plays

Marketing & Brand Investment
- Partner with Marketing to evaluate A&P (Advertising & Promotion) spend effectiveness and ROI

- Ensure optimal allocation of brand investment across sub-brands, campaigns, and media channels

- Track and report on brand P&L performance with actionable insights

Financial Planning, Reporting & Controls
- Lead the Monthly Business Review (MBR) process with variance analysis , risk/opportunity identification , and rolling forecasts

- Ensure robust internal controls, compliance , and governance across all financial processes

- Drive continuous improvement in reporting quality, automation , and data-driven decision-making

Cross-Functional Leadership
- Influence and challenge business decisions with a "Finance with a Point of View" mindset

- Represent Finance in S&OP / IBP (Integrated Business Planning) meetings

- Mentor and develop junior finance team members embedded in the category

Career Experience & Qualifications
- Education: CA/MBA (Finance) from a reputed institution

- Experience: 8–10 years of progressive finance experience, preferably in FMCG / CPG / Food & Beverage industry

- Strong experience in Category Finance is highly preferred . We are also open to candidates with diversified Business Finance experience, demonstrated through multiple stints across areas such as Commercial Finance, Supply Chain Finance, FP&A, Marketing Finance or other business partnering roles, bringing a well-rounded understanding of the end-to-end P&L and value chain.

- Proven track record of business partnering at a category or BU level — not limited to reporting or controllership

- Deep understanding of end-to-end value chain economics — from raw material to shelf

- Experience in Chocolate, Confectionery, or Snacking categories is strongly preferred

Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary

Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands—and mouths . Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. - Adaptability – responds resourcefully to new demands and challenges
- Strong analytical, critical thinking, listening and communication skills

- Strong ability to develop reporting packages in Power Point and Excel

As you take on greater challenges, you'll also gain greater visibility, making this a role where strong performance is noticed and valued. The position also offers strong career growth opportunities, including mentorship from senior leaders, cross-functional experience, and a clear trajectory into more senior finance roles within a global organization. jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

Mondelēz International empowers people to snack right in over 150 countries around the world. We're leading the future of snacking with iconic global and local brands such as  Oreo, Cadbury, Philadelphia, Pascall, The Natural Confectionery Company, Belvita, Ritz and Toblerone with global revenues exceeding $31 billion USD.

You will be at the heart of our Customer Service & Logistics (CS&L) team, driving continuous improvement through digital solutions that make a real difference. Reporting into the Continuous Improvement function, you will build and maintain a pipeline of digital initiatives — dashboards, automations, analytics, and reporting tools — that deliver measurable cost savings, service improvements, and efficiency gains across our logistics operations.

This is a hands-on role where you will own the digitisation target for CS&L, translating business problems into practical digital solutions with clear, trackable outcomes. You will also play a critical role in ensuring the sustainability and integrity of the digital infrastructure that supports the team — moving us from fragile workarounds to robust, documented solutions.

You are not a standalone function — you are embedded in the CS&L team, collaborating across functions and making the digital dimension of our collective goals a reality.

How you will contribute

You will:
- Build and maintain a live Digital CI Pipeline of improvement initiatives, each with a clear problem statement, solution design, estimated benefit, and delivery date.
- Design and deliver digital solutions — automations, dashboards, and reporting tools — that reduce cost, improve service performance, and simplify how people work. Solutions will require a mix of building these solutions directly and also working with SME’s on development.

- Support and build digital capability across the ANZ ISC (Integrated Supply Chain) including developing and facilitating training sessions on various digital tools and case studies. Effectiveness of training to be assessed through post training surveys and examples of self-serve on creating digital solutions, lunch-and-learns, and monthly updates — building digital capability across the function.
- Report monthly on pipeline health and savings delivered year-to-date, with benefits validated and signed off by stakeholders.
- Proactively identify opportunities where automation and digital tools can reduce manual effort, waste, or cost across logistics processes.
- Lead the National Distribution Control Tower project, maintaining a visible project plan with milestones, dependencies, and regular status updates for leadership. To include development and alignment of Business Requirements Documents (BRD) for each project phase, architecture and solution design requirements, facilitating integration, system and user testing, and hypercare support.
- Conduct infrastructure risk assessments across existing tools, platforms, and automations, and develop business cases to drive sustainable solutions.
- Support the Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S) methodology by embedding digital tools within each pillar, such as automated tracking for Autonomous Maintenance or data dashboards for Quality and Logistics.
- Maintain and enhance safety dashboards and digital reporting tools, ensuring they remain current and reliable.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
- Experience building and maintaining dashboards, automations, and data-driven reporting tools in a business environment. Experience with Power BI, Databricks, and SAP is preferred.
- Familiarity with logistics, supply chain, or FMCG/CPG operations — understanding the processes your digital solutions will support.
- Ability to translate business problems into practical digital solutions with measurable outcomes tied to a dollar value.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — comfortable working with data and turning it into actionable insight.
- Experience with or willingness to learn continuous improvement methodologies such as IL6S, Lean, or Six Sigma.
- Strong communication skills, with a collaborative, team-first mindset — you share knowledge, teach others, and work across functions rather than in isolation.
- Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, prioritise effectively, and flag risks early when timelines shift.
- Ideally experience with developing business cases including problem statements, options analysis, cost/benefit analysis, and ROI.
- A proactive approach — you spot opportunities and act on them without waiting to be asked.

More about this role

What you need to know about this position:
- You are the single point of accountability for the CS&L digitisation target, reporting progress directly to CS&L leadership.
- Your work will be visible, trackable, and tied to validated savings or measurable outcomes.
- You will balance new initiative delivery with maintaining and strengthening the sustainability of existing digital infrastructure.

Education / Certifications:
- Relevant tertiary qualification in information systems, data analytics, supply chain, engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

Job specific requirements:
- Demonstrated experience with data visualisation and automation tools (e.g. Power BI, Databricks, Power Automate, Python, or similar).
- Understanding of end-to-end supply chain or logistics processes is highly regarded.
- Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Work schedule:
- Standard business hours with no expectation of weekend work unless pre-agreed for a specific deadline.
- Hybrid working with option to work from Truganina or South Melbourne when in the office.

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.

As an organization we are committed to developing the next generation of Makers and Bakers. Joining us at an early career stage in our fast paced and ever changing environment will enable you to do more, learn more and grow more. You will be encouraged to step outside your comfort zone– you may even surprise yourself! We will ensure you are given the support you need to be at your best and enable you to be yourself and bring passion and personality. Here you can lean in and speak up and bring your own flavor.

Mondelēz International was recognized as one of the Top 100 Intern Programs in the US in 2026 by Yello & WayUp and one of the Best Companies for New Graduates by Forbes.

The Supply Chain Leadership Development Program is a three-year rotational experience designed to build a strong, end-to-end understanding of how our Integrated Supply Chain enables our business and delivers our products to consumers every day. The program offers two distinct tracks, a Supply Chain Management (SCM) Track and a Technical Track , each designed to develop future leaders through meaningful, hands-on experiences across different parts of the supply chain.
All participants will begin their first rotation in a Manufacturing setting, where they will learn how our plants operate end to end, lead continuous improvement projects, and build a strong operational foundation. From there, participants will rotate through headquarters and field assignments, gaining exposure to functions such as Supply Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Customer Service & Logistics, and other parts of our Integrated Supply Chain organization. Each rotation is designed to build on the last, developing progressively broader leadership capabilities over the course of the program.
Throughout the program, participants will take on meaningful roles and projects tied to real business priorities, working alongside cross-functional teams to solve problems, improve processes, and drive results. This is not a shadowing experience. Participants own real work with real impact and senior leadership visibility from day one.
Development extends beyond each rotational assignment. Participants will have access to master classes, functional and leadership training, site visits, a layered mentorship structure (including an Executive Sponsor, Program Lead, Functional Manager, and Dedicated Mentor), networking opportunities, and exposure to leaders across the organization. Digital and AI fluency will be embedded as a core development thread throughout all three years of the program.

By the completion of the program, participants will have built a comprehensive understanding of our end-to-end, demand-driven supply chain, developed a diverse set of experiences across the organization, and established a strong foundation to continue growing their career and making an impact within our ISC organization.
Start Date for this position will be: July 26th, 2027
This program requires geographic flexibility. Participants should expect to relocate once per year as they move through their rotational assignments. All relocations are fully supported through the program's relocation benefits.
Potential locations for the first year include:
- Chicago, IL

- Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree with a preferred graduation date of May 2027.

The ideal candidate is analytically curious, digitally fluent, and enterprise-minded. They lead through influence before authority, define progress by the people they develop and the systems they improve, and are ready to transform the supply chain from within. We are looking for candidates who demonstrate the following:
- Learning Agility: The ability to adapt faster than the environment changes. You thrive in ambiguity and pick up new concepts quickly.
- Influence Without Authority: You lead through ideas before titles. You can rally a team, build consensus, and drive outcomes through collaboration.
- Ownership and Accountability: You own outcomes, not just tasks. You are proactive, drive change, and take initiative without waiting to be told.
- Communication and Storytelling: You make the complex simple and inspire action through clarity. You can present to a room of operators or a room of executives with equal confidence.
- Analytical Thinking: You make evidence-based decisions. You are comfortable with data, root cause analysis, and translating numbers into actionable insights.
- Growth Mindset and Self-Awareness: You develop yourself first so you can develop others. You seek feedback, reflect on your experiences, and continuously improve.
- Collaborative Leadership: You build teams, not empires. You multiply capability and bring out the best in those around you.
- Resilience and Courage: You persist through ambiguity, make tough calls, and stand behind them. You sustain your energy and composure under pressure.
- Enterprise Thinking: You see the whole system and optimize for the organization, not just your function. You are curious about how decisions in one area impact the entire supply chain.
- Digital Fluency: You leverage technology to multiply impact. You do not fear disruption; you drive it. Comfort with AI, data tools, and emerging technologies is a must.

Ever wondered how some of your favorite snacks are made, moved, and brought to consumers around the world? Joining Mondelēz International gives you the opportunity to find out while building your career with a global organization behind some of the world’s most iconic brands.

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

You will support the I2M and IIM process for site / cluster and ensure  effective planning and execution of change as it relates to new and existing products, packaging and processes for a plant or cluster.  At the plant level you will work on change management and innovation management capabilities.

How you will contribute

You will:
- Support Project Development / Execution: Support I2M/IIM (Innovation 2 Market; Initiative Management) within the site; Provide site AR write ups & prepare critical site inputs to the Regional BD, specifically for IIM Design Reviews (DR2 – DR6); Leads Project Verification (DR7); Design Reviews (DR4) onward lead Plant activities: Master data, Art Work, Raw/Pack Material availability, Track timings – and report to project team. Act as the source of internal and external information (contact for Commercial stakeholders and is the key interface between Category and Engineering / Manufacturing / R&D). Lead site post project evaluation and communication, planning and execution of promotional activities within the I2M process
- Support Site Strategic Plan  / Annual Contract creation: Support the site director in developing the site strategy and plant road map. Be the key partner for Product Supply team on sourcing/capacity expansion – ensure full integration of Innovation/Renovation plans in 421 into site supply plans. Partner effectively with Engineering to build the site CAPEX budget. Ensure planning of the capital budget bottom up, including prioritization (i.e. integration with the full site agenda, specifically alignment of the annual timetable)
- Drive Ongoing business and Simplification: Integrate overall site change management agenda to ensure delivery of projects while maintaining service levels. Manage ongoing reprioritization, De-complexity agenda and support the delivery of the site productivity and improvement agenda. Ensure execution of regional /global menu cards and ensure that manufacturing hurdle rates are met. Support Product supply for assessment of manufacturing solutions for current supply and demand gaps in the site
- Lead, coach and build Capability of the Business development change coordinator(s) within the plant and other Key stakeholders.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
- Strong operational & manufacturing experience in CPG industry with experience in TPM-Total productive maintenance, 5s, LEAN, 6 sigma tools and concepts, Safety & GMP standard
- Good understanding of end-to-end processes in the manufacturing and business environment; working knowledge of commercialization process (I2M);  project leadership / management skills and technical and financial aspects of the business
- Strategic thinking, while having ability to excel in leading tactical programs
- Highly action oriented, drive for results, innovative, challenging actual set-ups, entrepreneurial ability
- Excellent communication (verbal & written), coaching, and leadership skills in a team-based environment
- Demonstrated abilities in analytics, problem solving and team building
- Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be able to work effectively with colleagues at all levels of the organization

More about this role
We are looking for a Business Development Manager who brings a  strong technical and engineering foundation , hands-on  manufacturing experience , and the  business mindset to drive transformation and step changes  across our supply chain network.
This role sits at the intersection of engineering, operations, and business strategy — driving end-to-end delivery of innovation and renovation initiatives from concept through commercialization. The ideal candidate is a technically grounded leader who can leverage deep knowledge of manufacturing and supply chain to unlock growth, challenge the status quo, and deliver meaningful change at scale.
If you come from a background in  Supply Chain Operations, Engineering, Program/Project Management, or Strategy with the required technical foundation, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape how we bring new products and capabilities to market.

What you need to know about this position:
Strategic Planning
- Partner with site leadership to develop and execute the site strategy and plant roadmap, integrating innovation and renovation plans into long-term supply plans

- Provide strategic thought leadership through scenario brainstorming, identification of project interdependencies, best practice sharing, and structured output review with senior stakeholders

- Serve as the key interface between Commercial, Engineering, Manufacturing, and R&D teams to align priorities and drive decisions

- Support the development of the site CAPEX budget in partnership with Engineering, ensuring bottom-up capital planning and prioritization

Innovation & Commercialization (I2M / IIM)
- Own and drive the Innovation-to-Market (I2M) and Initiative & Innovation Management (IIM) process at the site

- Lead Site IIM Pillar. Ensure project verification and design reviews (DR4–DR7), ensuring all site readiness milestones are met

- Ensure effective planning and execution of change as it relates to new and existing products, packaging, and processes

Project Execution & Governance
- Drive consistency and quality in project execution using appropriate methodologies and tools (e.g., LEAN, Six Sigma, Agile, Stage-Gate)

- Develop and manage project budgets, timelines, and resource plans

- Identify, assess, and mitigate project-level risks; escalate to leaders as needed

- Provide regular project reporting and status updates through scorecards, status reports, and stakeholder review meetings

- Confirm project completion, quality, and readiness to go live

Business Simplification & Productivity
- Collaborate across functions to continuously improve processes, deliver productivity, and support new product commercialization

- Support delivery of the site productivity and continuous improvement agenda

Stakeholder Management
- Own relationships with x-functional teams within and outside site

- Manage and influence stakeholders from tactical execution level through governance meeting

jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

As leader you will create strong partnerships across the business to ensure delivery of our Supply Chain strategies in line with our Growth agenda. You will be responsible for Leading, coaching and developing our Plant multi-functional teams to identify best practices and improvements that will increase our Reliability, Productivity, efficiency and effectiveness. Your goal will be to establish an Agile and synchronized Supply chain.

How you will contribute

You will:
- Works cross functionally to develop and implement a 3 year strategic plan and annual operating plan, proactively identify key opportunities and link strategy to action to enable safe, reliable, flexible and cost efficient manufacturing capability that is a demonstrable competitive advantage to Mondelēz.  Partner with multi-functional leads to define and meet Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Sustainability, Engagement goals. Establish a strong governance to review &  control operational performance and continuous Improvement plan and embed a zero loss mindset across the site to deliver against best in class both internally and externally
- Provide coaching towards implementation of IL6S-Integrated Lean 6 sigma ways of working and phase journey as per masterplan and Self-sufficient teams. Role model Values and principles through effective coaching, mentoring and development of the multi-functional team
- Accountable to protect the value of the assets through appropriate assessment of needs and planning of spend. Lead and be accountable for all Manufacturing standards, Governance, Compliance requirements are in place, understood by all employees at the site, and regularly reviewed and monitored for compliance to policy.
- Lead and be Accountable for Talent, Capabilities & Engagement for the Plant - identify and implement critical levers to attract, retain & develop critical talent and build capability at all levels, technical and behavioral, to build a sustainable workforce profile for the future.
- Interface with Key stakeholders internally & externally to establish/maintain effective relationships, align priorities in order to deliver the company objectives, goals and build the company equity and image.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

- Significant experience in leading manufacturing performance in a fast moving manufacturing environment with exceptional results (FMCG experience) with a career that has seen time at the Front Line and/or Manufacturing Manager level. Demonstrable and intuitive knowledge on fundamentals of good manufacturing practice, process improvement and optimization, Reconfiguration and imbedding of new or enhanced technology, Managing Costs and Variance, Motivaters and engagement levers for shop floor based performance, experience in TPM-Total productive maintenance, 5s, LEAN, 6 sigma tools and concepts
- Excellent communication (verbal & written), coaching, and leadership skills in a team-based environment. Demonstrated abilities in Analytics, problem solving and team building with a strong financial & business acumen, project management skills and Knowledge of industrial maintenance and manufacturing equipment.
- Experience in interfacing with the broader Supply Chain and Commercial functions and a high level of capability around managing relationships and outcomes with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Logistics, Customer Service, Category and Sales.

The Manager, Supply Chain Excellence will lead the end-to-end Operational Excellence strategy and continuous improvement agenda for the Puebla Plant, driving the deployment and sustainability of Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) principles and best practices across all operational pillars.

This role is accountable for embedding a culture of continuous improvement, strengthening operational capabilities, and delivering sustainable improvements in plant performance, productivity, quality, safety, and cost efficiency. The position requires a strong manufacturing background, cross-functional leadership experience, and proven expertise in implementing and managing comprehensive Operational Excellence programs.

The role will lead a team of direct reports and partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment, execution, and continuous advancement of the plant’s Operational Excellence roadmap.

Key Responsibilities
- Operational Excellence Strategy: Develop, lead, and execute the plant’s end-to-end Operational Excellence strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities and manufacturing performance objectives.
- TPM Program Leadership: Drive the implementation, maturity, and sustainability of TPM across all relevant pillars, ensuring consistent application of methodologies, standards, and best practices.
- Continuous Improvement: Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve operational performance, eliminate losses, optimize processes, and enhance equipment reliability and overall plant effectiveness.
- Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and other plant functions to embed continuous improvement into daily operations and drive a holistic approach to operational excellence.
- Capability Building: Develop organizational capabilities and foster a continuous improvement culture through coaching, training, standardization, and the development of operational excellence practices across the plant.
- Performance Management: Establish and monitor key performance indicators, track improvement initiatives, and ensure sustainable delivery of productivity, efficiency, quality, safety, and cost objectives.
- People Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop a team of direct reports, ensuring clear priorities, strong execution, and continuous capability development.

Qualifications and Experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
- Mandatory: Proven experience leading or deploying comprehensive Operational Excellence programs, such as TPM (Total Productive Maintenance), IWS (Integrated Work Systems), WCM (World Class Manufacturing), or equivalent structured manufacturing excellence systems.
- Demonstrated end-to-end knowledge and experience across all major pillars of a TPM-based Operational Excellence framework, beyond the implementation of isolated continuous improvement tools or individual pillars.
- Previous experience in manufacturing leadership roles, with exposure to different plant functions such as Manufacturing, Maintenance, and Quality.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across a complex manufacturing environment.
- Experience leading and developing teams, with strong people management and coaching capabilities.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and change management skills, with a track record of translating improvement strategies into measurable and sustainable results.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in the food and beverage or broader fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) industry.
- Familiarity with structured loss elimination, reliability improvement, and manufacturing performance management methodologies.
- Experience driving cultural transformation and capability building within large-scale manufacturing operations.

No Relocation support available
Business Unit Summary

Mondelez México has been in the country since 1927 and currently employs 6,000 wonderful people. Our diverse portfolio includes iconic and mouth-watering global brands such as Trident , Oreo , Philadelphia , and local jewels like Clorets and Bubbaloo . We are leaders in the making of cream cheese, powdered beverages and confections—in fact, we make seven out of every 10 chewing gums consumed by Mexicans. Our growth is supported by our cutting-edge manufacturing facilities, such as our Puebla Plant and Nuevo León HUB, which are the largest gums, candies and biscuits factories in the world in terms of volume. You can buy are products in 900,000 places in Mexico. We are also home to one of the 11 technology centers Mondelez International has worldwide, a specialized gum and candy facility that places us at the forefront of innovation and development in the country and drives our purpose to lead the future of snacking. We are pioneers in the country in work-life balance practices such as extended maternity leave, open spaces, remote work and flexible working hours.

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Únete a nuestra misión de liderar el futuro de Snacking. Hazlo con orgullo.

Asistir en la ejecución del flujo de trabajo de la gestión de ingresos, para ayudar a optimizar el retorno de la inversión en nuestras actividades de gasto comercial

Cómo contribuirás

Tus tareas:
- Trabajar con equipos de clientes para hacer un seguimiento de la evolución de los KPI de ingresos
- Completar evaluaciones posteriores acerca de las acciones promocionales en colaboración con finanzas y marketing
- Dar apoyo al Manager de Customer Planning, proporcionando informes regulares que incluyan seguimiento de volumen, gastos comerciales, % promocionado, seguimiento de actualizaciones estacionales
- Supervisar la conversión en ingresos de cualquier aumento de los precios de coste
- Trabajar con los equipos de clientes, finanzas y ventas para asegurar que todos los gastos de promoción en el sistema se acumulan correctamente
- Asistir a los estudios de previsión de negocio para comprender la dinámica de los clientes e identificar las oportunidades y los riesgos del plan
- Aprobar las actividades promocionales de acuerdo con las directrices, con revisiones periódicas de los gastos de promoción

Qué aportarás

El deseo de impulsar tu futuro y acelerar tu carrera junto con los siguientes conocimientos y experiencia:
- Visión financiera y comercial
- Reducción de la complejidad utilizando un enfoque analítico, disciplinado y de colaboración
- Sintetizar de datos provenientes de múltiples puntos en una sola posición integral
- Organización y priorización
- Capacidad de resolución de problemas
- Búsqueda de soluciones nuevas e innovadoras
- Se valorará la experiencia en sector de bienes de consumo de rápida evolución o productos empaquetados de consumo
- Se valorará el conocimiento del consumidor y la categoría

More about this role

Promotional capability within our Revenue Growth Management (RGM) function. This role will be the architect and leader of that capability — owning end-to-end promotional planning, execution, and optimization across all categories, all channels, and all customers in the Mexican market, with a strong emphasis on the Modern Trade / Autoservicios channel ​. They will lead the transfer and redesign of the promo process from another area, and drive adoption of new ways of working across Sales, Trade, Marketing, Finance, and RGM.

What you need to know about this position:

- Plan and execute the promotional plan across all customers, channels, and categories.

- Own the planning cycle and ensure monthly execution discipline across the full portfolio.

- Land the end-to-end (E2E) Promo Playbook: governance, Ways of Working (WoW), golden rules, and methodology.

- Lead post-mortem analyses of promotional events, maintain a learning repository, and continuously update golden rules and the living playbook.

- Drive a rigorous Gross-to-Net and P&L mindset in all promotional decisions.

- Connect promotional strategy with Pricing, PPA (Price Pack Architecture), Channel Strategy, Brand Strategy, and overall business priorities.

- Act as the bridge between commercial and financial perspectives, ensuring promo investments are aligned with the broader RGM agenda

- Build credibility and trust to become the go-to voice on promotional effectiveness.

- Lead the transfer of the promo process from another area; redesign it and ensure cross-functional adoption (Sales, Trade, Marketing, Finance, RGM).

- Build from the ground up: process, governance, tools, and organizational structure for the new Promo capability.

- Lead and develop a team of analysts , building their capabilities and ensuring they grow ​

Education / Certifications:
Bachelor's degree in Administration, Business, or related fields.
Job specific requirements:

- 5–8+ years of experience in Revenue Growth Management, Trade Marketing, Commercial Planning, or Commercial Finance within CPG/FMCG.

- Hands-on experience with Promo / TPM tools (e.g., TPM systems, promo optimization platforms, or equivalent).

- Strong analytical and financial profile: comfortable with P&L management, Gross-to-Net waterfalls, ROI analysis, and promotional post-mortems.

- Knowledge of Trade & Category Management (Catman): shopper insights, shelf strategy, and how promo connects to in-store execution.

- Fluent in the language of commercial analytics: price elasticity, price ladders, price points, promotional lift, cannibalization, and incrementality.

- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing without direct authority.

- Strong people leadership skills: ability to develop talent, delegate effectively, and build high-performing teams.

Work schedule: Full time

jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.
We are looking for a Supply Chain Business Development Director who brings a  strong technical and engineering foundation , hands-on  manufacturing experience , and the  business mindset to drive transformation and step changes  across our supply chain network.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, operations, and business strategy — driving end-to-end delivery of innovation and renovation initiatives from concept through commercialization. The ideal candidate is a technically grounded leader who can leverage deep knowledge of manufacturing and supply chain to unlock growth, challenge the status quo, and deliver meaningful change at scale.

If you come from a background in  Supply Chain Operations, Engineering, Program/Project Management, or Strategy with the required technical foundation, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape how we bring new products and capabilities to market.
What You Will Do

Strategic Planning & Network Optimization
·        Partner with site leadership to develop and execute the site strategy and plant roadmap, integrating innovation and renovation plans into long-term supply plans
·        Lead network design and optimization, including long-term capacity planning and multi-year scenario modeling to identify investment, divestment, plant consolidation, and greenfield opportunities
·        Provide strategic thought leadership through scenario brainstorming, identification of project interdependencies, best practice sharing, and structured output review with senior stakeholders
·        Develop and implement growth and productivity strategies in close collaboration with cross-functional teams including Commercial, Finance, R&D, Engineering, and Manufacturing — ensuring alignment across the full value chain
·        Serve as the key interface between Category, Commercial, Engineering, Manufacturing, and R&D teams to align priorities and drive decisions
·        Lead capacity and sourcing assessments to address current and future supply and demand gaps
·        Support the development of the site CAPEX budget in partnership with Engineering, ensuring bottom-up capital planning and prioritization

Innovation & Commercialization (I2M / IIM)
·        Lead the end-to-end commercialization of new innovation, from concept through to market launch
·        Own and drive the Innovation-to-Market (I2M) and Initiative & Innovation Management (IIM) process at the site or cluster level
·        Lead project verification and design reviews (DR4–DR7), ensuring all site readiness milestones are met
·        Ensure effective planning and execution of change as it relates to new and existing products, packaging, and processes
·        Lead site post-project evaluations and communicate outcomes to key stakeholders

Project Execution & Governance
·        Drive consistency and quality in project execution using appropriate methodologies and tools (e.g., LEAN, Six Sigma, Agile, Stage-Gate)
·        Develop and manage project budgets, timelines, and resource plans
·        Identify, assess, and mitigate project-level risks; escalate to leaders as needed
·        Provide regular project reporting and status updates through scorecards, status reports, and stakeholder review meetings
·        Confirm project completion, quality, and readiness to go live

Ongoing Business Simplification & Productivity
·        Collaborate across functions and bakeries to continuously improve processes, deliver productivity, and support new product commercialization
·        Integrate the overall site change management agenda to maintain service levels while delivering projects
·        Manage ongoing reprioritization and de-complexity initiatives
·        Ensure execution of regional and global menu cards and that manufacturing hurdle rates are met

Productivity
·        Own Productivity delivery for your pillar including in-year NP deliverables and future year pipeline sufficiency development
·        Support delivery of the site productivity and continuous improvement agenda

Stakeholder Management
·        Own relationships with x-functional teams and manufacturing sites, ensuring quality assurance across all phases of project delivery
·        Manage and influence stakeholders from tactical execution level through steering committee, driving alignment and effective decision-making

Team Leadership & Capability Building
Build high-performing, cross-functional teams across internal and external partners

More about this role
Experience & Background
·        Technical or engineering degree  (or equivalent experience) with a strong foundation in manufacturing, process engineering, or supply chain operations
·        Significant hands-on manufacturing experience  in a CPG or FMCG environment — with a deep understanding of plant operations, process improvement, and technical problem-solving
·        Proven experience in  supply chain operations, program/project management, or strategy
·        Demonstrated experience in  network design, capacity planning, and multi-year scenario modeling  — including investment, divestment, consolidation, and greenfield analysis
·        Demonstrated experience in  commercializing new products or innovations  — from pipeline development through to launch execution
·        Track record of  driving transformation and step-change improvements  — not just incremental gains — through cross-functional collaboration and strategic execution
·        Track record of  developing and implementing growth and/or productivity strategies  in collaboration with cross-functional teams
·        Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain and manufacturing processes, including commercialization (I2M or equivalent)
·        Familiarity with capital budgeting, resource planning, and financial aspects of project delivery

Technical Skills
·        Working knowledge of  TPM (Total Productive Maintenance), 5S, LEAN, and Six Sigma  tools and methodologies
·        Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Stage-Gate, Agile, MS Project, or equivalent)
·        Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights — including scenario modeling and financial analysis
·        Knowledge of relevant business processes and supporting technology solutions (ERP, MES, etc.)

Leadership & Mindset
·        Entrepreneurial and transformation-oriented mindset  — able to identify growth opportunities, challenge the status quo, and drive step-change results with a bias for action
·        Strong business acumen  — understands how engineering and supply chain decisions translate into commercial outcomes and category growth
·        Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) — able to engage effectively from shop floor to executive steering committee
·        Strong stakeholder management and ability to positively influence decision-making across functions and levels
·        Strategic thinker with the ability to excel in leading tactical, hands-on programs
·        Demonstrated coaching and team-building capabilities
·        Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with colleagues at all levels of the organization

Salary and Benefits:

The base salary range for this position is $142,700 to $235,455; the exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education and location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program with possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results and eligibility to participate in our long-term incentive program.

In addition, Mondelez International offers the following benefits: health insurance, wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education related programs, paid holidays and vacation time. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible

You will oversee demand planning activities for your assigned product families in your business unit. You will also lead the demand review process and driving interactions with the cross-functional teams.

How you will contribute

You will:
- Lead the demand management agenda for the category, being the key interface between commercial (sales revenue planning) and supply (replenishment) to identify and evaluate the impact of potential availability issues/commercial changes including gap assessment and risk and opportunity discussions
- Partner with modelling team for the generation of statistical forecasting
- Manage, coach and develop a team
- Review standard consumption versus forecast at the customer and total product levels, liaising with replenishment and sales revenue planning to manage potential availability issues and the impact of under consumption
- Drive strong linkages with the commercial, customer collaboration, modelling, order fulfilment teams and supply planning including innovation and equity
- Drive continuous capability building in the demand planning team for planning improvement

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
- Comprehensive supply chain, economic, financial or logistics experience and commercial awareness in a fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment
- Open to learn new ways of working and is willing to use new tools
- Experience driving demand review and participation in an IBP cycle
- Able to influence cross-functional teams, working on the key priorities and improving the plan
- Able to build effective teams
- Knowledge in leading practice demand planning and end-to-end supply chain concepts
- Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills and verbal and written communication skills

More about this role

The IBP Category Lead will lead the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process for their respective business unit and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the development and execution of an accurate demand forecast. This role drives supply chain efficiencies, improves forecast accuracy, and identifies risks and opportunities to optimize business performance. A key part of the role involves collaborating with and influencing stakeholders through data-driven storytelling and continuous improvement initiatives.

What You’ll Do

- Lead, manage, coach, and develop a forecasting team, driving continuous capability building for planning improvement.
- Oversee the development of an unbiased, unconstrained 24-month forecast with properly documented assumptions.
- Partner with Category Finance to ensure appropriate linkage between IBP and financial forecasts, including key assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
- Collaborate with the Modelling Team to generate statistical forecasts.
- Work with Commercial Leadership to quantify and validate risks and opportunities, supporting plans to close gaps between forecast and targets.
- Partner with Innovation and Equity teams to validate the sizing of new products (innovations, renovations) and campaigns within the 24-month forecast.
- Collaborate with Supply Planning to ensure confidence in the demand plan, facilitating timely, appropriate forecast decisions for successful execution and delivery.
- Identify, communicate, and monitor risks and opportunities to the demand plan (e.g., abnormal demand, demand shaping, changes in sales forecasts, budgets, and strategies), supporting risk assessments and mitigation.
- Collaborate with Marketing and cross-functional teams on product lifecycle analysis, managing introductions and exits to optimize service and waste KPIs.
- Drive and enhance demand planning processes, leveraging available technologies and proposing improvements to boost efficiency and accuracy.
- Own and facilitate the Monthly Demand Planning process within the IBP/S&OP cycle, presenting changes and recommendations during monthly reviews.
- Participate in IBP meeting cycles, including supply meetings and volume reviews, to address demand changes.
- Lead demand plan updates, ensuring aligned information is accurately captured in systems and communicated to Supply Chain, Finance, Sales, and other key stakeholders.
- Support the generation of the demand plan for the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) process in collaboration with Sales, Business, and Finance teams.
- Lead cross-functional forecast-related projects, collaborating with Supply Planners to resolve capacity, inventory, and supply gaps, including critical allocation recommendations and their tie to CFR recovery projections.

What You’ll Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

- Post-secondary education with an APICS/ASCM and/or IBF certification (University degree or professional designation required).
- 10-12 years of experience in demand planning and forecasting within the CPG or similar industry.
- 4+ years of team management experience.
- Comprehensive supply chain, economic, financial, or logistics experience with strong business acumen.
- Openness to learning new ways of working and a hands-on approach to using data and systems.
- Significant experience driving demand review and participation in an IBP cycle.
- Strategic agility, able to drive cross-functional results by proactively managing key issues and priorities.
- Maturity and tact to effectively work with cross-functional teams, managing conflicting priorities and ambiguity.
- Strong senior leadership influencing skills and organizational agility; proven ability to build effective teams.
- Knowledge of leading practice demand planning and end-to-end supply chain concepts.
- Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication (verbal and written) skills, with the ability to interpret large volumes of data and provide actionable insights.
- Advanced proficiency in MS Office (specifically Excel for pivot tables, modeling) and experience with ERP and APS (SAP APO and/or o9) systems.
- Proven ability to collaborate with and manage relationships across cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance).
- Experience with continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma) and familiarity with change management.
- Strong business acumen, with the ability to assess both short-term and long-term impacts of business decisions.
- Experience with PowerBI, MRP, and supply chain management systems is an asset

Salary and Benefits:

The expected base salary range for this position is $102,600 to $128,250 CAD depending on several factors such as experience, skills, education, and budget. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible to participate in a highly competitive bonus program with a target of 14% with the possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results.

Mondelez also offers several generous employee benefits (some subsidized or fully paid for by the company), including health insurance, wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education related programs, and enhanced vacation and holiday entitlements.

AI may be used as part of the recruitment process and in accordance with local laws.

Many of our iconic brands are ranked first, second or third in their categories, and our manufacturers and pastry chefs have an enviable mission to create and manufacture chocolate, cookies, crackers and candy in our iconic factories and locations across Ontario. A company with many ambitious growth targets, we have invested close to $250 million in our Ontario plants in recent years alone; We run marketing campaigns promoting innovative products such as Cadbury Dark Milk tablets and OREO Birthday Cake and Peppermint Bark cookies. Our community of more than 2,683 employees is present across Canada and our head office is in Toronto. Passion and dedication characterize our Company.
